info.title: Ritme Salamat API
info.description: API Documentation for Ritme Salamat Application

get.description: Retrieve paginated list of user's daily health logs with optional date filtering

post.summary: Create or update daily health log
post.description: Create a new health log or update existing one for the specified date. Each user can have only one log per day.

get.description: Retrieve a specific health log entry for the given date

message.example: No health log found for this date

delete.description: Delete a health log entry for the specified date

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Date of the log to delete (YYYY-MM-DD)

message.example: No health log found for this date

get.description: Retrieve all available enum values for dropdown fields in the health log form

post.description: Sends a 4-digit OTP to the mobile number. Creates new user if not exists.

new_user.description: True if this is a new user registration

message.example: Please wait before requesting a new OTP
Failed to send OTP. Please try again.

post.summary: Verify OTP and get access token
post.description: Verifies the OTP code and returns access token. Creates user if new.

message.example: Too many attempts. Please request a new OTP.

get.description: Retrieve the authenticated user's profile information

post.description: Create or update the authenticated user's profile information including menstrual cycle data

period_duration.description: How long does your period usually last? (days)

cycle_duration.description: How long does your cycle usually last? (days)

last_period_start.description: When did your last period start?

bearerAuth.description: Login with email and password to get the authentication token
bearerAuth.name: Authorization
